Question 4
Explain the below terms in detail:
4a. Cryptography
Answer
Cryptography is the process in which the information is “scrambled” so that certain
pieces of the information is hidden
4b. Encryption
Answer
Encryption is the process of converting a message from one system of communication
to another. 4c. Decryption
Answer
The process of converting a coded message back to its plain text form

5a. LIN (Local Interconnection Network)
Answer
LIN is a communication protocol which is primarily used for simple networking tasks,
primarily due to it being cost effective. Unlike CAN it adopts a Serial Bus System, hence
lacks the high speed and the complex architecture available on CAN bus.

1. Adherence to OEM specifications and Industry Standards – Suppliers must
strictly adhere to cybersecurity specs provided by the OEM and comply with
relevant industry standards like the ISO/SAE 21434. 2. Secure Development of Components and Software
a. AUTOSAR Implementation: Suppliers developing AUTOSAR-based
software must ensure their implementations are secure, even if OEMs
define the specific cryptographic algorithms. This includes secure coding
